run_pipeline_img2img: run latent consistency img2img pipeline to transform an input image using a text prompt
create_scheduler_timesteps: create lcm scheduler with custom timesteps for multi-step inference
encode_text_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings for diffusion model conditioning
add_noise_to_latents: add noise to image latents at a given timestep for diffusion noising
step_scheduler_denoise: step the lcm scheduler to denoise a latent sample to the previous timestep
